rendered:
The paper "Anode-Free Sodium Battery through in Situ Plating of Sodium Metal" by Adam P. Cohn et al. measures the sodium nucleation overpotential on aluminum current collectors. 

According to the paper, the sodium nucleation overpotential on bare Al is 19 mV, and it is reduced to 12 mV by the carbon layer.

prompt.system: You answer questions using only the documents below: pages selected from them, with tables written row by row. Answer briefly. If you compute a number, show the calculation. If the question assumes something the documents contradict, say so. If the documents do not hold the answer, say so.

expect: nanolett-6b05174 ('Anode-Free Sodium Battery through in Situ Plating of Sodium Metal'): from 19 mV (bare Al) to 12 mV (carbon/Al) (p2.L58-62)
